summary: Completed testing of Admin Regions/Cities Management and Providers Map View features - Backend API (11/11 tests PASS) and Frontend UI (all features working). Regions with 102 cities across 8 Israeli regions with GPS coordinates. Map view with Leaflet/OpenStreetMap working.

issues: Cookie consent dialog appears on page load - minor UX concern but not a bug

critical_code_review_comments: All 11 backend API tests pass - full CRUD for regions and cities with coordinates
Fixed bug in DELETE /api/admin/regions/{id}/cities/{city_name} - was using invalid $or inside $pull
8 regions of Israel initialized with 102 total cities on first API call
Each city has Hebrew name, English name, and GPS coordinates (lat/lng)
Providers search with GPS returns distance_km when coordinates provided
Map view uses Leaflet with OpenStreetMap tiles
Provider markers show on map with popup details including distance

bug_fixed.issue: MongoDB $or operator inside $pull was causing 520 server error
bug_fixed.fix: Changed to sequential $pull operations - first try removing city object by name, then fallback to string removal
